sentences.text:
Learned Additional Government Advocate takes notice for respondent Nos.1 and 2.
2.

Sri.H.C.Shivaramu, learned counsel takes notice for respondent Nos.3 and 4.
3.

It is the contention of petitioner No.1 that he is the absolute owner of the land bearing Sy.No.14/2 measuring 1 acre and petitioner No.2 is the owner of land bearing Sy.No.14/4 measuring 1 acre and both these lands are situated at Alanahalli Village, Kasaba Hobli, Mysore Taluk.
That they are in possession and enjoyment of the same ever since the date of purchase.

That the aforesaid lands were sought to be acquired by the respondent-MUDA in terms of a preliminary notification issued under Section 17 of the Karnataka Urban NC: 2023:KHC:32899 Development Authorities Act, 1987 dated 09.10.1997 for the purpose of formation of Vidhya Nagara Layout.

entities.text: Karnataka Urban NC: 2023:KHC:32899 Development Authorities Act, 1987
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further contention of the petitioner that though the preliminary notification has been issued as far as back in the year 1987,
till date
neither the award is passed nor the compensation is paid or the final notification is issued.
The respondent-MUDA has issued endorsement dated 18.08.2023 as per Annexures-D and E confirming that the final notification has not been issued in this manner.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in the above circumstances and in view of the law laid down by this Court in the case of C.G Gangadhara vs. Mysore Urban Development Authority,
Mysore and another reported in 2013 (4) KAR.L.J 559, the petition is liable to be allowed.

entities.text:
C.G Gangadhara vs. Mysore Urban Development Authority,
Mysore and another reported in 2013 (4) KAR.L.J 559
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Sri.
H.C.Shivaramu, learned counsel for the respondent-MUDA does not dispute the aforesaid factual aspect of the matter.
In that view of the matter, the petition is allowed holding that acquisition is abandoned to the extent of the property of the petitioners is concerned.

Sd/-
